title: IS43/46TR82560C DDR3 x8 to 16x16 controller BGA
description: A deliberately spacious, multilayer DDR3-memory-to-controller BGA routing problem using a real vendor DDR3 ballout; the benchmark is paired-BGA connectivity, not board compaction.

ddr3.note: Ball population and signal assignments follow the vendor datasheet. The 0.38 mm PCB land is a conservative autorouting benchmark parameter, not a production land-pattern recommendation.

placement.componentGapDefinition: minimum horizontal clearance between the two pad-field edges
